title: Is Amazon FBA Still Worth Starting In 2026? TRUTH Revealed!
summary: Amazon FBA seller shows revenue versus fees and profit, argues generic private label is dead but niche branding and a TikTok flywheel still work; funnels to coaching.

assertions.quote: you just take a junk product from Alibaba, you slap your brand on it, and you put it on Amazon. That doesn't work anymore

verdicts.note: Seller counts, fee increases and Chinese direct sellers have compressed margins on undifferentiated goods.

assertions.quote: even though we did $900,000 in revenue, that number is not profit
I probably was working less than four hours a week on average

verdicts.note: Possible with staff and a mature product, but that excludes the setup labor and the paid help.

assertions.quote: people that join this program are 25 times more likely to actually start and succeed with their Amazon business
they're going to cut you out and they're going to sell directly to Amazon and keep all that profit for themselves

verdicts.note: Both models are widely reported as thin-margin and vulnerable to brand gating and supplier disintermediation.
The complaint describes online arbitrage as reselling for a small profit on the price difference, and the stores were mostly suspended; nothing on suppliers cutting sellers out.

assertions.quote: mine's the only one that's branded for this specific niche

verdicts.note: Differentiation by niche is a real edge, but these are one seller's cases and copycats follow quickly.

assertions.quote: This leads to a virtuous cycle of more and more money if you do it right.

verdicts.note: Off-Amazon traffic does boost rank, but the flywheel depends on influencer uptake that most products never get.

assertions.quote: if you know what you're doing, you're never going to have to worry about a Chinese seller

verdicts.note: Consumables with local branding are harder to clone, but Chinese sellers now dominate many categories and tariff rules shift.
